content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text gives UNDERDETERMINED for D5 vs C5 based on the wording and prophetic application of the single Isaiah 7:14 verse.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. When one verse's words carry two meanings at once, both stand; the verse is not open.","room":"When one verse's words carry two meanings at once, both stand; the verse is not open: I weighed reading one, that the two Isaiah 7:14 aspects must both stand and cannot make the verse open; reading two, that separately answered wording and application leave it underdetermined.","why":"The judge's UNDERDETERMINED treats the separately answered virgin/young-woman wording and prophetic application as leaving Isaiah 7:14 open, contrary to K-S2's command that when one verse carries two meanings at once both stand and the verse is not open."}
